tool_arguments.prompt: Create ONE square3x3 sprite sheet, EXACTLY NINE separate full-body drawings of the SAME reference bird, in row-major order. Freshly draw every pose from this exact adopted identity/style reference. It is a simple rounded background bird prop in a children's watercolor picture-book universe, NOT a human mascot or realistic wildlife painting. Compact cream and brown Philippine eagle prop, gray hooked beak, brown dot eye, tan swept crest as the same few broad simplified feather shapes; no extra feather shards. Retain warm brown outline, paper-grain watercolor flat color blocks, plain brown DOT eye with no white surround, no sparkle, no human hands/arms/teeth/lips. Keep original body proportions, wing/tail count, feet anatomy and palette consistent across all9. Exactly3rows3columns, no labels/grid/captions; wide truly alpha-zero gutters separating each whole bird from every neighbor, generous transparent outside margin; place each bird around330px native height in each418px cell at uniform body scale, all feet on common corresponding support line. Keep full bill/wing/tail tips inside its own cell; do not shrink some poses or put a bird into adjacent cell. Background fully transparent, no ground, haze, shadow field, extra props or effect marks. Nine cells: (1) quiet blink, unchanged ordinary body with eye gently closed; (2) friendly greeting using ONE existing wing eased slightly out, feet stable; (3) attention/presentation to VIEWER LEFT by head/bill and existing wing oriented left, no hand; (4) attention/presentation to VIEWER RIGHT by turning head/bill right and existing wing oriented right, NOT mirror-copying the whole bird, keep identity/tail consistent; (5) thoughtful gentle head tilt and subtle up gaze, no extra arms; (6) discovery head slightly lifted and bill slightly open, no human mouth or symbols; (7) happy eyes closed with existing wings gently lifted a little, feet grounded, no extra feather shards or flight; (8) A modest wing-opening gesture while keeping the bird supported in its reference stance; use a few broad rounded colour shapes.; (9) The same wing starts folding toward the body; retain the reference bill, legs, tail and simple eye style.. Keep all9 bodies the same scale and height except deliberately tilted head/wing, no change in belly volume or eye format. Crisp but warm drawn contours and clean intentional paper texture.
